_doc: Move specific appearances off a shared same-name record onto their own person, BEFORE apply_merges. Run by split_appearances.py right after split_swilliams. Each rule: from (canonical_name + source), the appearances whose context starts with context_prefix, and the new person's canonical_name. 'renames' fix a record's display name by id; 'move_refs' move Winch reference notes (matched by note prefix) from one record to another.

rules.context_prefix: Reform lectures of John Allen in Pittsburgh
rules.note: North Star, Feb. 18, 1848: a Massachusetts land reformer lecturing in Pittsburgh. Not the John Allen who was secretary of the 1827 Protecting Society; split off 2026-11-01 so that record could merge into Winch's Allen, John (Michiko's ruling).

renames.name: Colley, Daniel
renames.note: Winch heads this entry 'Colly or Colley, D[aniel]' (bootmaker, tanner and currier, 189 S. 6th; Vigilance Committee 1839); the import had taken a later line as his name. Michiko confirmed 2026-11-01.

renames.name: Mead, Mary
renames.note: Carries the death date from Winch 'Meade, Mary' (d. 1854), merged into this record 2026-11-01.
